4. Such cryptic order cannot be nomenclated as judicial or quasi  j u d i c i a l o r d e r .
O r d e r m u s t r e f l e c t t h e a p p l i c a t i o n o f m i n d b y t h e j u d i c i a l  f o r u m o r t h e t r i b u n a l .

sentences.text:
a b e t t e r f o o t i n g t h a n t h e c a s e o n h a n d  inasmuch as in the case on hand, no dates and events and cause for delay is narrated, in the  P o s t M a s t e r G e n e r a l a n d o t h e r s ( s u p r a ) , 
such dates and events were narrated and delay of 427 days was not condoned by the Apex  C o u r t o n f a i l u r e o f t h e a p p l i c a n t t o p l a c e o n  record the better particulars.

It was observed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court thus:
"29.

In our view,it is the right time to inform all the government  bodies, their agencies and instrumentalities that unless they have  reasonable and acceptable explanation for the delay and there was bonafide  effort, there is no need to accept the usual explanation that the file was  k e p t p e n d i n g f o r s e v e r a l  months/years due to considerable degree of procedural red tape  in the process.
The government departments are under a special  obligation to ensure that they perform their duties with diligence and commitment.
C o n d o n a t i o n o f d e l a y i s a n e x c e p t i o n a n d  should not be used as an anticipated benefit for the government  departments.

The law shelters everyone under the same light and  should not be swirled for the benefit of a few."
R
In above view of the matter impugned order cannot be sustained.

Accordingly the same is quashed and set aside and the application for  condonation of delay being Application No. 18 of 2017 is restored to file of the  Tribunal for its reconsideration in accordance with law.
Accordingly appeal is allowed to the above extent.

7. Criminal Misc. Application No. 15273 of 2017 is disposed of. 
Rule is discharged.
